verdict.rationale: Rollbar's own docs show it tracks code versions and deploys against errors: it shows which versions throw exceptions, deploy notifications unlock debugging features, and the marketing page says it connects errors with releases and points to the code behind each error. However, the evidence never shows a per-issue 'first seen in release' field or a suspect-commit attribution. missing for 10: explicit first-appeared-in-release display per item, documented suspect-commit identification, how commits are linked via SCM integration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can associate errors with releases and commits so each issue shows the release it first appeared in and the suspect commit that likely caused it

citations.quote: Rollbar allows you to see which versions of your code are throwing exceptions.
If you notify Rollbar every time you deploy or release your app, you'll unlock several features that will help your debugging process.
connects errors, replays, and releases in one place, and points you to the code behind each error.
